Automated Order Review with Anomaly Detection

Order-to-Cash / Salesforce · Agent-orchestrated pipeline + Anomaly detection + Human approval — automate Salesforce order processing while detecting anomalies, validating critical invoicing fields, and routing exceptions for review.

Each order goes through processing and validation. Valid orders are pushed to Dynamics 365 and marked Successfully Processed. Orders needing review move to Waiting Approval; approved ones are manually processed and pushed to D365, while failed validations trigger an email and are marked Validation Failed.

How it works

  1. Fetch order - pull the order from Salesforce and mark it Processing.
  2. Anomaly detection - score the order with an Isolation Forest model and flag unusual orders for audit.
  3. Invoice validation - an agent checks the critical fields (PO number, billing details, contact, pricebook, amount; contract for high-value orders).
  4. Decision routing - validation passed: push to Dynamics 365 and mark Successfully Processed; failed: mark Waiting Approval and route to a human reviewer.
  5. Human approval - approved: mark Manually Approved and push to D365; rejected: mark Validation Failed, email remediation and request a Salesforce data correction.

Final outcomes

  • Successfully Processed
  • Manually Approved & Processed
  • Validation Failed
  • Anomaly score generated for audit & monitoring

How to use — what to pass

The agent takes one or more order_id values (it loops over them). Open the Chat tab or run the agent with an order id.

Sample order ids:

  • 801gK000011hp6EQAQ
  • 801gK000011hp6FQAQ
  • 801gK000011qD6XQAU

Building blocks (Polars workflows)

The agent orchestrates these workflow tools via Workflow Execution nodes:

  • Fetch Order From Salesforce JDBC - pull the order record.
  • Isolation Forest Model Training / score Order Anomaly - train and score the anomaly model.
  • SF Validate Invoicing Fields JDBC - validate the critical invoicing fields.
  • Set Status (Validating / Validation Failed / Rejected / Waiting Approval / Manually Approved / Successfully Processed) - write the order status back.
  • SF Push Approved Order / Push Order to D365 - push the approved order to Dynamics 365.

How it stays trustworthy

  • Grounded in live systems - the order is fetched from Salesforce and pushed to Dynamics 365; nothing is guessed.
  • Anomaly-aware - every order is scored by the Isolation Forest model so unusual orders are visible and auditable.
  • Human-in-the-loop - orders that fail validation wait for a reviewer to approve or reject before anything is committed.
  • Status-tracked - each order carries an explicit status at every step, and rejections trigger a remediation email.

The Agents tab shows the orchestration canvas with an overview note describing every step.
